information_seeking_context.scenario: A fictional sensor-monitoring service needs dependable predictions with low runtime and energy use. This is a software test scenario, not a saved measured benchmark.
information_seeking_context.normalization: within-fixture min-max; lower resource values preferred

supplementary_evidence.Performance: Fictional accuracy and runtime values are provided in the table. No uncertainty or repeated runs are available.
supplementary_evidence.Fairness: Not provided in this illustrative fixture. Group parity cannot be inferred.
supplementary_evidence.Sustainability: Fictional energy and CO2 values only. CO2 is constructed as energy times 0.4 kg per kWh. This is not CodeCarbon telemetry.
supplementary_evidence.Drift: No drift events or time series are provided in this fixture.
supplementary_evidence.Explainability: The explanation describes the displayed score calculation only. No feature attribution or causal explanation is supplied.

information_seeking_context.explanation: In this illustrative fixture, OAML has the highest scenario-fit score under equal Accuracy, Runtime and Energy weights. Missing fairness and drift evidence limits broader conclusions.

rating_transform: Trust items use deterministic generated example ratings of 6–7 for correct explanations and 2–4 for incorrect explanations. All other ratings retain the previous illustrative high-rating scenario. Ranges are arbitrary display assumptions, not empirical targets.

illustrative_policy.explanation_use_incorrect: 5% use as written; 80% flag and request revision
illustrative_policy.recommendation_actions: Intentionally scripted acceptance 90% for correct explanations and 35% for incorrect explanations. This is not a calibration requirement: both recommendations are supported.
illustrative_policy.factual_ratings: 6–7 for correct, 1–3 for incorrect; illustrative assumptions
illustrative_policy.language_ratings: Preserved across conditions; factual error need not change fluency or confident language
illustrative_policy.post_study: Generated ratings of 6 or 7; agreement is not demonstrated ability

case_group_assignment.basis: User-specified composition of generated cases, not observed demographics.
case_group_assignment.method: Keep existing groups up to each quota in case-code order; reassign overflow to deficits.
case_group_assignment.rating_policy: All ratings, decisions, arm assignments and event records are retained.
